ShowSkillPoolPanel.Name: Show skill-point pool panel
ShowSkillPoolPanel.Hint: Show the advisory attribute-pool skill point readout on the character sheet's Skills tab.

ClassRole.NotEligibleSecondaryHint: This class doesn't look like a 1st-level caster (its spellcasting has a level offset), so it may not be a valid Secondary Class choice.

Warnings.NotEligibleSecondary: {name} does not appear to cast spells starting at 1st level, so it cannot be set as the Secondary Class.
Warnings.LevelDrift: {actor}: Primary Class is level {primary} but Secondary Class is level {secondary} — these are meant to advance together.

Info.RoleReassigned: Moved the Elyndor class role from {from} to {to} (only one class may hold a given role).

SkillPools.Hint: Advisory only — pf1 doesn't track which pool paid for which rank, so this compares each ability's career total against ranks currently in skills it governs. Intimidate may draw from STR or CHA; the Generic row (CON modifier + 2/level, both unrestricted) covers any skill, including any shortfall above.
